outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement - ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. - Fremont High School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Consolidated Engineering Laboratories $28,666 for materials testing at The Center @ Foster
enrichment.summary: Consolidated Engineering Laboratories will provide materials testing and construction project services for the new greenhouse, tool shed, sink enclosure and canopy at The Center @ Foster. The firm is the selected consultant. Work runs from January 28, 2021 to December 31, 2021.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Materials Testing Services - Consolidated Engineering Laboratories - The Center @ Foster - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
